booking.name: Booking deposit
booking.what: Holds your slot for a meeting or video call with Anirudh.
rules: Pay the ₹1,499 deposit (+18% GST, ₹1,769 in all) before you book your slot — it holds your meeting or video call with Anirudh.
Go ahead with any audit within 14 days of your consultation: the full deposit is adjusted against the fee.
Attend but don't go ahead: no refund — the deposit pays for the meeting.
No-show, or not answering calls: the deposit is forfeited.
Running late: the meeting still ends at the slot's scheduled time.

tracks.name: Property documents
tracks.who: For resident and NRI buyers, one property

tiers.name: Property Document Inspection
tiers.deliverable: An independent inspection of one property's documents, done with AKRES's document-review partner. You receive written findings: what is in order, what is missing, and what to ask before you pay. The document list is confirmed with you before payment.

notes: All fees are plus 18% GST, including the booking deposit.
The booking deposit is adjusted against whichever audit you choose, provided you book it within 14 days of your consultation.
Scope: a risk and investment assessment, not a legal title certificate or a structural survey.
